note: The name Odin matches several unrelated projects, and I could not tell which one, if any, is the target system. Candidates seen in search results: (1) Agnt/Odin, a minimalist CLI agent written in the Odin programming language (github.com/manelsen/agnt); (2) getodin.ai, a commercial no-code agent-building platform; (3) deepklarity/harness-kit, an open-source harness-engineering kit that includes a multi-agent orchestration CLI called odin; (4) OutlineDriven/odin-claude-plugin, a plugin for coding-agent harnesses, formerly the ODIN Claude Plugin; (5) Odin-Agent-, a personal agentic workspace. Uber's 'Odin' stateful platform is cluster infrastructure, not an AI system. Only search-result snippets were read; no candidate page was opened, and none gave a first public release date, so no date is recorded. The lab note 'unknown' and kind note 'harness' are not confirmed by any source. To settle this, the user needs to name the repository, company, or launch announcement for the intended Odin, after which its releases page or first commit can be checked.
